rows.en:
And guess what? Those scales came gushing out of the faucet, mixed in with the water.
He yanked his hands back, but it was too late.
His hands were caked with scales.
He tried brushing them off, he tried shaking his hands, but the scales wouldn't come off.
Then, without thinking, he glanced at the mirror over the sink.{p}

"Aaaaaaagh!"
He screamed.
Because his whole face was covered in scales, packed tight.
The very same scales he'd torn off that carp the day before...
And on the side of his neck, a fish's gills were flapping open and shut.
By then, he couldn't make a sound anymore.
All you could hear was the wheezing whistle of gills breathing.
And webbing had grown between his fingers...{p}

Later, they say he was found hanged in that restroom.
And when they found him, he looked just like he used to, no scales, no gills...
Was he just seeing things...?
Ever since then, they say scales still turn up on the floor of that restroom every now and then.
Feeling sick?{p}Don't want to hear any more?
I don't want to hear it
Tell me the rest

You don't want to hear it?
I see. It's pretty gross, after all.
If you don't want to hear it, that's fine by me.
I'll just tell you this much: you'd better not go near that restroom.
Whatever happens, I'm not taking any responsibility, okay?
That's the end of my story.{p}

I really wanted to tell you more, though...
Oh well. If the seventh one doesn't show up, the next story is the last.{p}
Huh, so you don't like them.{p}

What? But you like eating fish?
Oh, okay, I get it.
You don't like them as pets, but you like them as food.
You're a practical one, aren't you, {a}{f:|}?{p}

"Aww, there, there.
You want me to torment you that badly?"
He said it with a grin.
Then he pinned the carp down with his foot and peeled off its scales one by one.{p}

"Squeeeeeee!"
The carp let out a sound like a scream.
Of course he couldn't carve up a carp as neatly as a real chef.
By the time he'd pulled out its guts and cut into its back, the carp had stopped moving.
That was when he learned something for the first time.
When a carp gets that big, it bleeds red blood, just like a human...{p}
In a rage, he hacked the carp in front of him to shreds.{p}

Then he flushed the chunks of carp flesh down the toilet.
He'd thought it would give him more fun than that... A little let down, he left the restroom.{p}

You want to know what happens next, huh?
All right, I'll tell you.
After what happened, nobody used that restroom anymore.
There was no point leaving a restroom nobody used just sitting there, so they decided to tear it down.
But when they called in contractors to demolish it... bad things happened.
Everyone involved in the work, they say, was tormented by nightmares.
In the dream, scales and gills and webbing grew all over their bodies.
One night would've been bad enough, but it went on for days.
And it happened to every single person involved.
They all got scared to sleep, and on top of that, none of them could eat fish anymore.
So the work was called off.{p}

I said scales still turn up in that restroom now and then, right?
If you ever see one, don't touch it, whatever you do.
Apparently your skin swells up like scales wherever it touches.
...And so, that's the end of my story.
Still, the seventh one sure is late.
I wonder what happened.
I hope nothing bad's happened.
Well then, shall we hear the next story?{p}

Oops, too bad.
Actually, it was a tanuki.
Well, to people like us, a tanuki and a fox are pretty much the same thing, right?
Anyway, about why that restroom stopped being used.{p}

A long time ago, there was a tanuki at this school.
Not that anybody kept it in the animal hutch or anything.
This school's right in the middle of the city, but somehow a tanuki wandered in.
So everyone thought it was a rare sight, and they made a fuss over it.
Every day, around lunch break, it would come out into the back courtyard to get fed.
I mean, animals are cute, right?
Everyone was happy to share their lunches with it.
But after a while, they got bored of it.
Nobody paid it any attention anymore.{p}

But there was one.
One student who kept taking care of it.
Unfortunately I don't know his name, but he was a boy.
He fed it every single day.
He even gave it a name.
I don't know what the name was, so let's just call it Ponkichi.
Ponkichi got really attached to him, too.
But if a teacher found out, he'd be in trouble, right?
Our school's especially strict about animals like that.
They say they bring fleas and lice and stuff.
So he thought it over.
If it kept coming out every day somewhere this visible, a teacher was bound to find it sooner or later.{p}

He built a nest box inside one of the stalls in the boys' restroom and had Ponkichi live there.
"Sorry, it smells a little, but please put up with it.
And I'm going to put a lid on so you don't wander off. You can put up with that, right?"
With that, he stretched netting over a cardboard box, rigging it so Ponkichi couldn't sneak out and roam around during class.{p}
That day, too, he wolfed down his lunch early, took the leftovers, and hurried off to Ponkichi.{p}

"Sorry I'm late. You must be hungry, huh?"
He said it as he walked into the restroom, and then the shock was so great that he dropped his lunch box.{p}
What do you think happened?{p}

Believe it or not, Ponkichi was dead.
To be precise, Ponkichi had been killed.
Here's how it started.
It was during classes that morning.
A certain student was skipping class and loafing around near that restroom.
He heard an animal crying from somewhere, and, curious, he searched inside the restroom.{p}

He found Ponkichi right away.
"What the hell is this thing..."
He wasn't especially interested in tanuki, but he took it out of the box anyway, just because.
Ponkichi thrashed and tried to get away.
Not about to let go of his new toy, he held on to Ponkichi tight.
Then Ponkichi bit down on his finger with a 'chomp!'{p}
"Ow! You little bastard!"{p}

He slammed Ponkichi onto the floor.
Slipping out of his hands, Ponkichi tried to run.
"Get back here, you little bastard!"
He hurried and grabbed Ponkichi.
"Don't think you're getting away."
He gripped Ponkichi firmly and hugged it to his chest, careful not to get bitten again.{p}

"All right, you're gonna be my toy.
I'm gonna kill some time with you, nice and slow.
Brace yourself."
With that, the guy started tormenting Ponkichi.{p}What do you think he did to Ponkichi?
Water torture
Burning at the stake
Torn limb from limb
Paraded through town, crucified, then the head put on display

"All right, I sentence you to be torn limb from limb."
With that, he tied Ponkichi to a pillar so it couldn't escape and started tormenting it.
"First, we split your legs."
The guy grabbed Ponkichi's hind legs and yanked them apart as hard as he could.
The hip joints shattered, and the legs dangled limply.
"Heh heh heh heh heh. What a sweet sound...
Now the front legs."
With that, he grabbed Ponkichi's front legs this time and yanked them apart the same way.
"Hee hee hee hee hee.
The way it shakes right through my hands, I love it..."
What a horrible guy, huh?
I bet his face looked just like a demon's right then.{p}

With its leg joints shattered, Ponkichi couldn't run away. It couldn't even writhe.
"Now, what should I do with you next?
I want to feel more bones crunch...
If I wring your neck, though, you'd die for sure..."{p}

The way he saw it, the fun was in tormenting a tanuki while it was still alive.
He had no intention of killing it quickly.
He went and got one of the concrete blocks stacked outside and brought it down as hard as he could on the hind legs hanging slack and limp.
"Hmm, that's not much fun.
Nowhere near as good as how it felt before..."
Its hind legs crushed, Ponkichi wept tears from the unbearable pain, twitching in spasms.{p}

"Huh, so tanuki cry too...
That's funny.
I'm gonna make you cry some more."
He tried this and that, and finally found a method that worked.
Tearing out Ponkichi's fur.
When he grabbed a tuft and ripped it out as hard as he could, tears streamed from Ponkichi's eyes.
He kept at it until there was no fur left on Ponkichi's back.
"Man, I'm starting to get bored.
If I leave it like this, it'll probably die anyway..."
Saying that, he grabbed Ponkichi by the neck and wrung it as hard as he could.
"Heh heh heh... That feels good..."
At last, Ponkichi stopped moving altogether.
Then he tossed Ponkichi into the cardboard box and walked out, just like that.{p}

Afterward, the boy who'd been taking care of Ponkichi found it.
He was heartbroken.
"Who would do something so cruel..."
Wanting at least to give it a grave, he made one beside that restroom and buried it there.{p}

Then a few days went by.
All that time, he never once missed visiting the grave.{p}

That day after school, too, he went over to the restroom to visit the grave.
And there was someone wrecking the grave.
Furious, he ran right up to the guy.
"What are you doing?!"
He confronted him, his face bright red.
But the guy got angry instead and punched him.
And then he said,
"I'm the one who killed the tanuki."
Just like that.
When he heard that, he went at the guy with his fists.
But he was no match for him at all.{p}

Instead, he got beaten to a pulp and dragged into the restroom.
The guy must have figured he'd beat him all he liked, where no one could see.
And he kept on beating him.
So much that the whole restroom ended up covered in blood.{p}

After that, he stayed home from school for several days until the swelling went down.
When he went back, everyone was talking about one particular boy.
Apparently that student had fallen off a station platform on his way home from school and been run over by a train.
They say his body was torn into pieces, and it was really gruesome.{p}

And, as it turned out later, that student was apparently the one who'd killed Ponkichi.
Scary, huh?
By coincidence, he ended up dying the same way Ponkichi did.
But to me, it doesn't seem like a coincidence at all.
I think there's something more to it.
What do you think, {a}{f:|}?{p}

So, about the restroom next to the gym.
Apparently, it's haunted.
By the ghost of that guy who got torn to pieces.
That ghost goes,
"It's your fault I ended up like this,"
muttering it over and over, they say.
Everyone wondered why it would haunt a place like that.
But either way, it was haunted all the same, so everyone got creeped out and stopped using that restroom.{p}
Actually, there's more to this story. Do you want to hear it?
No, that's enough
Please tell me more

All right.
Then I'll tell you the rest.{p}

The boy who'd been taking care of Ponkichi, see, he figured something out.
That it must have been Ponkichi getting revenge.
It made him feel a whole lot better.
After that, the days went by without anything happening.{p}

"Is someone there?"
But there was no one in the restroom.
(That's weird.)
The moment he thought that...{p}

It showed up.
He couldn't believe it.
The guy who'd killed Ponkichi was standing beside a stall door.
"It's your fault I'm dead.
Your fault... your fault..."
Saying that, the ghost lunged at him.{p}

And at last, he was cornered inside a stall.
"Help! Somebody, heeeelp!"
No matter how much he screamed, there was no sign of anyone coming.
(It's over...)
It was right as he thought that{p}

that he saw Ponkichi appear behind him...
"P-Ponkichi..."
(You came to save me!)
Thinking that, he felt relieved.
But that was a huge mistake.{p}

Sure, thanks to Ponkichi, the ghost went away.
I bet that ghost took one look at Ponkichi and ran off.{p}

After that, he started acting strangely.
Not so you'd notice if you just glanced at him, though.
In fact, even his friends in class didn't notice at first.
What was he doing, you ask?
Well, every lunch break, he'd disappear.
Without even eating his lunch.
Every break, he'd take his lunch box and go off somewhere.{p}

And when he came back, his lunch box was completely empty.
His classmates just assumed he was eating his lunch somewhere.
But during the next class, his stomach was always growling.
As if he hadn't eaten a thing.{p}

At first, everyone made fun of him.
Still hungry after eating your lunch? they said.
But as the days went by, he got thinner and thinner, wasting away.
A friend who was worried about him followed him to see where he went at lunch break.{p}

And it turned out he was going to the hill behind the old school building.
He went to a certain spot, and instead of eating his lunch, he was throwing it away.
The friend went up to talk to him, meaning to ask why he was doing that.
And the friend was shocked.
His face had changed.
That's right, it looked like a tanuki's face.
The friend warned him.
Don't throw your lunch away. Eat it, or you'll die.
But he wouldn't listen.
He said these guys needed to eat more than he did.
The friend didn't get what he meant.
Who were 'these guys'?
But on a closer look, near where he'd been throwing his lunch, there were what looked like the corpses of baby tanuki.
He'd been bringing food to the baby tanuki.{p}

And finally, he died.
Of malnutrition.
Apparently he hadn't been eating anything at home, either.
After that, they say the friend died the same way too.{p}

After that, anyone who went into that restroom died the same way.
So a rumor started.
That if you go into that restroom, something will possess you.
There had already been rumors that the restroom was haunted, so nobody used it anymore.{p}

Ponkichi must have been coming to the school looking for food.
And yet it got shut in by the boy.
So Ponkichi's babies couldn't get food, and they starved to death.
Even so, Ponkichi must have possessed him, desperate to bring them food.
I bet it still hasn't realized its babies are dead.
Kind of sad, isn't it?{p}

That's what happened in that restroom.
How do I know all this, you ask?
That's easy.
Most students at this school probably know about it.
As a rumor, anyway.
You're still a first-year, {a}{f:|}, so it's no wonder you didn't know.
I can't say whether the story's true or not.
Actually, I think some parts have been exaggerated...
Whether you believe it or not is up to you.
Well, that's the end of my story.
Finally, there's only one left.
I wonder if the other person's ever going to show up.
Doesn't look like it, huh?
Let's hurry up and finish, and go home.
I'm starving...{p}
"All right, I sentence you to water torture."{p}
With that, the guy tied up all four of Ponkichi's legs so it couldn't move.{p}
Then he grabbed Ponkichi by the tail and headed for the sinks.{p}

He filled one with water and shoved Ponkichi's face into it.
In agony, Ponkichi lifted its head to breathe, just like doing a sit-up.
But it couldn't hold its head up for long, and its head would drop back into the water.
Watching that, the guy was delighted.
"Come on, come on, if it hurts, keep that head up.
Hee hee hee hee hee..."
Every time its head went under, it swallowed water and its body got heavier.
On top of that, it was coughing as it struggled, so Ponkichi soon wore out and couldn't lift its head anymore.{p}

"Here, puke."
He shook Ponkichi up and down.
"Ghk... ghk..."
Ponkichi threw up every bit of the water it had swallowed.
No matter how much he shook it, all that came out now was drool.
"Okay, you puked, so now I gotta flush."{p}
The guy put Ponkichi in the toilet bowl and flushed.{p}
